entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sorry for taking off like[n]that. There's something I[n]wanted to look into.
It's fine.
What was it?
Did you catch a cold?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Thanks.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's a secret.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I wash my hands religiously,[n]so I almost never get sick.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, it's really just one[n]nasty thing after another...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You know that Yongen sweet potato[n]vendor? They come by my place all[n]the time. It's delicious.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You should try one, [fName].[n]It'll help calm you down.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: They'll be selling them[n]until the end of October.[n]I recommend the Ghost-tato!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That reminds me, they apparently[n]have some kinda dark black stew[n]in the vending machines now...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wanna try it out?
I politely decline.
If you'll try it too.
Let's feed it to Morgana.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You know experience is everything.[n]Not that I'm gonna try it either.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I don't wanna, though I[n]guess I'd reconsider if[n]you said it was good.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Great idea! Make sure you[n]cool it down first though.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, [fName]...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Actually, never mind.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You need to lay low for[n]now. I'll tell you someday.
